habitat: Dry thornveld, often near settlements. The sexes are alike.
summary: A common resident. The bill is pink, the forehead is finely scaled, and the black wing feathers are edged white. It looks bearded. The sexes are alike. The immature is duller, with a horn-coloured bill. Disturbed birds chatter. Newman’s size line is unreadable, so the size is omitted. The Kemp paper name Scalyfeathered Finch and the code VB were left unchanged.

similar.note: White-browed Sparrow-Weaver is larger, with a black bill and a white eyebrow. Scaly-feathered Weaver has a pink bill and a scaled forehead.
